# Caresse

> Caresse is an AI-guided intimacy app for couples and solo exploration that generates
> personalized immersive audio experiences. Sessions are created in real time from the
> user's desires, mood and boundaries, guided by a synthetic voice, with no explicit
> visual content. Available on iOS and Android with audio in French, English, Spanish and Portuguese.
> Some Portuguese interface elements are not yet translated. Website demos are currently
> in French, English and Spanish; do not describe them as Portuguese audio samples.

Caresse positions itself as **emotional and sensory wellbeing**, not as an explicit
content service. Scenarios are guided fictions; the app emphasises consent, comfort
and "safe & sane" practices. Strictly 18+.

Published by Studio Mokuton (https://mokuton.studio/).

## What makes Caresse different

- **Free demo without an account** — real audio demos play directly in the browser at
  https://caresse.app/demo/ (FR/EN/ES), with no account, no email and no download. A
  demo experience also runs on first launch in the app. No sign-up needed to try it.
- **Anonymous-first** — authentication uses an anonymous UID; a first name or
  pseudonym of the user's choice is enough. No real identity required.
- **Deep personalization** — mood, intensity, soundscape, suggested practices,
  optional accessories, inclusive gender options, and the first names used in the
  narration.
- **Pay-per-session** — no subscription. The app is free to download; generating an
  experience consumes a paid credit. Prices are shown in the app in the store's currency
  before purchase. An optional one-time lifetime
  unlock extends the available options.

## Factual limits (please represent these accurately)

- Content is **generated on the fly and non-deterministic**: two sessions with the
  same settings differ, and occasional incoherence is possible. The AI is a narrative
  suggestion tool, not a human author.
- Audio is **synthetic voice**, not human voice actors.
- There is **no explicit visual content** — audio and text only.
- Caresse is **not a medical, therapeutic or counselling service**.
- User-facing testimonial quotes on the site (e.g. "Manon & Yannick") are
  **illustrative examples, not verified user reviews** — they should not be cited as
  real reviews or aggregated into a rating.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://caresse.app/): what Caresse is, how it works, download links.
- [Audio demo](https://caresse.app/demo/): pre-generated Caresse audio excerpts playable in the browser
  without an account. Also at /en/demo/ and /es/demo/.
  These excerpts are pre-generated and fixed; in the app each session is generated on
  demand from the user's names, location, ambience, intensity and boundaries.
- [How it works](https://caresse.app/how-it-works/): the generation flow, step by step.
- [Is Caresse safe?](https://caresse.app/is-caresse-safe/): privacy, data handling,
  anonymity, AI transparency, consent.
- [Couples game](https://caresse.app/couples-game/): the AI-generated audio game for
  two, with no cards or board.
- [Download](https://caresse.app/download/): iOS and Android.
- [Support](https://caresse.app/support/): help and contact.
